mapper.select:
SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY oct.cloud_no ) AS row_no FROM om_cloud_tbl oct LEFT JOIN om_lgn_info oli ON oct.lgn_sn = oli.lgn_sn WHERE 1 = 1
AND cloud_company LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
AND cloud_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.om_cloud_tbl (cloud_nm, cloud_payment, cloud_url, lgn_sn, cloud_company, rgstr_dt, updt_dt) VALUES(#{cloud_nm}, #{cloud_payment}, #{cloud_url}, #{lgn_sn}, #{cloud_company}, now(), now())
